title: A gable roof at 42 degrees inside the chamber
summary: Every roof plane of the chamber leans 42 degrees from vertical and the planes meet in a ridge: no flat ceiling and no support inside, with 3 degrees of margin to the 45 degree overhang limit.

rejected.why: on the printing notes' scratch body a dome puts 6.4 % of the surface past 45 degrees (worst 79.9), against the 0.5 % the overhang evaluator allows; a support inside a closed chamber cannot be taken out

returns_if.text: when the bird is printed as two halves or with supports that dissolve: assumption C28 rules both out

rejected.value: flat strips under the ridge (the acoustics-first concept)
rejected.why: four flat patches of about 10 x 5 mm, bridges of 10.5 to 12 mm inside the chamber, where a loose strand cannot be reached; they bought 6.5 cm^3 of chamber (144.9 against 138.4 cm^3)

returns_if.text: when the body cannot give the chamber volume and bridges of 10 mm or more are accepted inside: the model's bridge limit is 5 mm

rejected.why: no margin: the concept drawn at 43.5 degrees failed the overhang evaluator at every mesh resolution tried (0.71 to 0.82 % of the surface past 45 degrees against 0.5 % allowed), and the one at 43 degrees had 4384 mm^2 of roof within 2 degrees of the limit

returns_if.text: when a printed roof coupon justifies an overhang limit above 45 degrees
